note: Rows filed under an employer of the postings registry that are not that employer's plants, as the research of 2026-11-23 found them (scripts/build-not-theirs-sql.mjs builds the migration). 'to' moves the row to the company it is: the firm the research names, or the firm the row's own name names (a dealer, a namesake, a business sold long ago), found by exact name or other name and created bare when there is none. 'mergeInto' folds a row that is the same plant written twice into the row that is it (plant_merge). 'from' is the company the row is filed under today: a row that is no longer there is left alone. No row is deleted. A dealer is no plant: it stays, under a company of its own name, until the owner decides.
